samples.title: bus 31 heater
samples.body: Morning, the heater on 31 is out again. Third time since Christmas. It blows but its cold air and by the time I get to the Smithville stop the windshield is fogging on the inside and I'm wiping it with my glove which you know is not safe. Kids are sitting there in coats and hats and the little ones are complaining there feet are cold and I don't blame them. I told the shop on Friday and Ray said it was the blend door but I don't think they fixed nothing because its doing the same exact thing. Can I get a spare til its fixed for real? I don't care which one long as the heat works. 27 would be fine I drove it before. Also the wiper on the drivers side is streaking, not a big deal but while they got it in there. Thanks, Gary

samples.title: fish fry friday
samples.body: Hi Linda, I can do the fryer again this friday same as last week, I'll be there by 3:30 once I drop my afternoon kids. Couple things. We ran low on the tartar sauce right around 6 and people noticed, so maybe get the big jugs from Gordons not the little ones. And the one fryer on the end is running hot I think the thermostat is going, the fish was coming out dark before it was done in the middle. I turned it down but somebody should look at it before Lent is over. Bob said he could bring his if we need it. Otherwise it went good, I heard we did 340 dinners which is the most I remember. Tell the youth group kids they did a good job on the tables they hustled. Gary

samples.title: truck tires
samples.body: Hi, I was in last month and you guys put 4 new tires on my 2014 Silverado, the guy at the counter was Mike I think. The front passenger one keeps going down like 5 or 6 pounds a week. I been airing it up at the Speedway but I'm getting tired of it lol. I don't think I ran over nothing, no nail I can see. Is that covered since it was just put on? I can bring it in any day after 9 since I'm off for summer, school don't start til the 19th. Let me know what day is good, I'd rather not wait til it goes flat on the highway. Thanks Gary Hollins
